name: fetch_push_dense_v0_wall_clock
description: FetchPushDense-v4 benchmark with a fixed wall-clock training window.
notes: Use this benchmark when comparing FetchPush training recipes under equal wall-clock time.
RGB rendering is enabled by default so dashboard frames are available for live monitoring.
train_episodes is a high safety cap; train_seconds is the intended budget.
The HER seed is a natural alternative for this goal-conditioned manipulation task.
